metadata.description: Agent Skills for QRGen, the open-source barcode, QR code and ID scanning SDK for web, iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, .NET, Node.js and Python.

plugins.name: qrgen-sdk
plugins.description: Skills that teach coding agents to integrate QRGen scanning into any app: camera scanners, batch scanning, ID scanning, barcode generation, GS1/AAMVA parsing, migrations from other scanner libraries, and camera-free testing.
